<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="es" data-theme="light"><head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">

  <title>Statiskicks — Scouting Software</title>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/x-icon" href="https://www.statiskicks.com/custom_assets/logos/logo_white.png?v=1787321828">

  
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net">

  <!-- Google Fonts -->

  <link href="https://www.statiskicks.com/custom_assets/css/sk.css?v=1794168592" rel="stylesheet" data-navigate-track="">

  <link rel="preload" as="image" href="https://www.statiskicks.com/custom_assets/logos/footer_logo.png?v=1787321828">

  <link href="https://www.statiskicks.com/custom_assets/css/team-header.css?v=1794084628" rel="stylesheet">
<link href="https://www.statiskicks.com/custom_assets/css/team-pass-network.css?v=1792708794" rel="stylesheet">
<link href="https://www.statiskicks.com/custom_assets/css/match-list.css?v=1793360776" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  .team-page { min-height: calc(100vh - var(--sk-navbar-total, 64px)); }
  .team-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr); gap: 1rem; }
  .team-card { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .team-card--span-3 { grid-column: span 3; }
  .team-card--span-4 { grid-column: span 4; }
  .team-card--span-5 { grid-column: span 5; }
  .team-card--span-6 { grid-column: span 6; }
  .team-card--span-7 { grid-column: span 7; }
  .team-card--span-8 { grid-column: span 8; }
  .team-card--span-12 { grid-column: span 12; }
  .team-snapshot { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: .6rem; }
  .team-snapshot__item { border: 1px solid var(--border-light); border-radius: 8px; padding: .75rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,.03); }
  .team-snapshot__label { display: block; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: .68rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; }
  .team-snapshot__value { display: block; margin-top: .25rem; color: var(--text); font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 800; }
  .team-table-wrap { width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; }
  .team-table { width: 100%; min-width: 760px; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; font-size: .82rem; }
  .team-table--stats { min-width: 620px; }
  .team-table th { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; }
  .team-table th, .team-table td { padding: .65rem .55rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); vertical-align: middle; }
  .team-table td { color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .team-ranking td strong { color: var(--text); font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; }
  /*
    The squad tables are the advanced search's results table (sk.css). Beside
    the age profile, a quarter of a full-width row, the featured players drop
    the avatar and let a long name wrap so five columns fit without scrolling.
  */
  .team-featured-table .sk-player-table__avatar-link { display: none; }
  .team-featured-table .sk-player-table__player-text { white-space: normal; }
  .team-featured-table thead th, .team-featured-table tbody td { padding-left: .3rem; padding-right: .3rem; }
  .team-featured-table .sk-player-table__rank { width: 1.25rem; }
  .team-card--xxl-3, .team-card--xxl-9 { min-width: 0; }
  @media (min-width: 1400px) {
    .team-card--xxl-3 { grid-column: span 3; }
    .team-card--xxl-9 { grid-column: span 9; }
    .team-featured-card { padding: 1.25rem 1rem; }
  }
  .team-visual-card { min-height: 360px; }
  .team-visual-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: .75rem; }
  /* Ranking and Mapas y Gráficas on a plan without them: made-up stand-ins, blurred (.sk-unlock-ghost), under the call to the plans. */
  .team-locked { min-height: 520px; overflow: hidden; }
  .team-locked__table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--text); }
  .team-locked__table th { text-align: left; font-size: .7rem; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); padding: .6rem .5rem; }
  .team-locked__table td { padding: .6rem .5rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light); }
  .team-locked__category td { font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; background: var(--bg-secondary); }
  .team-locked__chip { display: inline-block; padding: .05rem .4rem; border-radius: 4px; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; color: #102018; background: #b2d98b; }
  .team-locked__chip--mid { background: #f5d547; }
  .team-locked__chip--low { background: #f4a259; }
  .team-locked__maps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 2fr); gap: 1rem; }
  .team-locked__toggle { display: inline-flex; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .team-locked__pitch { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
  .team-locked__line { fill: none; stroke: var(--border); stroke-width: 3; }
  .team-locked__dot { fill: #b2d98b; opacity: .8; }
  @media (max-width: 768px) { .team-locked__maps { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .team-locked__filters { display: none; } }
  .team-locked__compare-head { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .team-locked__compare-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; }
  .team-locked__compare-side { margin: .5rem 0 .3rem; font-size: .82rem; color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .team-locked__compare-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; }
  .team-locked__compare-track { flex: 1; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-secondary); overflow: hidden; }
  .team-locked__compare-bar { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f4a259, #f5d547, #b2d98b); }
  @media (max-width: 992px) { .team-locked__compare-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }
  /* Perfil de edad: the subtitle beside the title, clear of the card's download button; it wraps under it on a narrow card. */
  .team-visual-header--inline { justify-content: flex-start; align-items: baseline; column-gap: .75rem; row-gap: .15rem; padding: 0 7.5rem .75rem 0; margin-bottom: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); }
  /* sk.css rules a card's heading off under its last line and pads a title clear of the download button; here the header does both, across the card. */
  .sk-card .team-visual-header--inline .sk-card-title,
  .sk-card .team-visual-header--inline .sk-card-subtitle { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; }
  @media (max-width: 576px) { .team-visual-header--inline { padding-right: 2rem; } }
  .team-chart-wrap { position: relative; width: 100%; min-height: 460px; }
  .team-chart-wrap canvas { width: 100% !important; height: 460px !important; }
  .team-formation-stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: .6rem; }
  .team-formation-stat { border: 1px solid var(--border-light); border-radius: 8px; padding: .75rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,.03); }
  .team-formation-stat span { display: block; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: .68rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; }
  .team-formation-stat strong { display: block; margin-top: .25rem; color: var(--text); font-size: 1.15rem; }
  .team-formation-note { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: .78rem; margin: 0; }
  [data-pass-network-node]:focus, [data-pass-network-edge]:focus { outline: none; }
  .team-content { position: relative; }
  .team-content--loading { opacity: .58; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .12s ease; }

  /* Ranking (Fase 3): the title, then the unit and the attribute picker on the right. */
  .team-ranking__head { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: .75rem 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: .75rem; }
  .team-ranking__head .sk-card-subtitle { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .team-ranking__controls { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  /* The two pills one width: the toggle's two buttons share the attribute button's. */
  .team-ranking__controls .chart-toggle { min-width: 164px; }
  .team-ranking__controls .chart-toggle-btn { flex: 1 1 auto; }
  /* Plantilla (Fase 7): the Estadísticas tab's head, its controls level with the title, and the advanced search's hand-off link. */
  /*
    The title and the controls share one row, the subtitle and the card's
    rule under both: a card too narrow for the controls beside the title
    wraps them under it, never under the subtitle, so the table stays close.
  */
  .team-squad__head { align-items: center; gap: .5rem 1rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
  /* sk.css rules off a title with no subtitle beside it; here the rule is the subtitle's. */
  .sk-card.team-squad .team-squad__head > .sk-card-title { margin-bottom: 0; padding-bottom: 0; border-bottom: 0; }
  .team-squad__head + .sk-card-subtitle { margin-bottom: 1rem; padding-bottom: .75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); }
  .team-squad__handoff { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent-ink); text-decoration: none; }
  .team-squad__handoff:hover, .team-squad__handoff:focus-visible { color: var(--text); }
  /* Resultados (Fase 7): the label, and the rival menu at its right. */
  .team-matches__head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .5rem 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: .75rem; }
  .team-matches__head .team-matches__label { margin-bottom: 0; }
  /*
    Comparar (SK-12, SK-12.1): three cards a row, two on a tablet, one on a
    phone, each team's crest and name over its bar. The head's three controls
    share one row, their labels level with the title, so the card is no
    taller than it has to be; on a narrow screen they wrap under the title.
  */
  .team-compare__head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem 1.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .team-compare__head .sk-card-title + .sk-card-subtitle { margin-bottom: 0; }
  /* The controls are the Resumen's (sk.css .sk-analysis-filter-field): same pills, same widths. */
  .team-compare__controls { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: .75rem 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .team-compare__chart { position: relative; transition: opacity .2s ease; }
  /* The download is the controls' last, level with the title, as the player page's corner buttons are. */
  .team-compare__controls .sk-chart-download-btn--inline { align-self: flex-start; }
  /* Only while the network is drawn: before it lands, or without one, there is nothing to save. */
  .team-pass-network-card:not(:has(.team-pass-network-pitch)) > .sk-chart-download-btn,
  .team-pass-matrix-card:not(:has([data-team-pass-matrix-table] tbody)) > .sk-chart-download-btn { display: none; }
  .team-compare__chart--loading { opacity: .55; pointer-events: none; }
  /* The columns follow the chart's own width, so a download laid out narrower (Fase 6) takes fewer. */
  .team-compare__chart { container: team-compare / inline-size; }
  .team-compare__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; }
  .team-compare__card { display: grid; gap: .85rem; margin: 0; padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem; animation: team-compare-in .36s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1) backwards; animation-delay: calc(min(var(--i, 0), 12) * 30ms); }
  .team-compare__title { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: .5rem; margin: 0; font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text); }
  .team-compare__hint { flex: none; font-size: .66rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted); }
  .team-compare__side { display: grid; gap: .4rem; }
  .team-compare__club { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .45rem; min-width: 0; font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .team-compare__club span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
  .team-compare__club img { flex: none; object-fit: contain; }
  .team-compare__placeholder { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .75rem; min-height: 320px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: 700; }
  @keyframes team-compare-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-10px); } }
  @container team-compare (max-width: 860px) { .team-compare__grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
  @container team-compare (max-width: 520px) { .team-compare__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .team-compare__controls { width: 100%; }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .team-compare__card { animation: none; }
  }
  .team-tab-panel { display: none; }
  /*
    Every tab comes in the same way when it is picked: a short fade and rise.
    display:none to block restarts the animation on each switch. `backwards`,
    not `both`: once it ends no transform is left on the panel, which would
    otherwise become the containing block of its position:fixed modals (the
    attribute picker). The period toolbar, shown or hidden by tab, does the same.
  */
  .team-tab-panel.is-active { display: block; animation: team-tab-in .32s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1) backwards; }
  .team-page .sk-detail-context-toolbar { animation: team-tab-in .32s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1) backwards; }
  @keyframes team-tab-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .team-tab-panel.is-active,
    .team-page .sk-detail-context-toolbar { animation: none; }
  }
  /*
    On the Resumen tab the period is picked in its "Periodo de análisis" card,
    beside the chart controls, as on the player page; the toolbar keeps that
    job on every other tab. Both drive the same league and season.
  */
  .team-page[data-active-team-tab="overview"] .sk-detail-context-toolbar { display: none; }
  /* A tab this plan sees only blurred has nothing to pick a period for, so it shows no toolbar either. */
    .team-page[data-active-team-tab="stats"] .sk-detail-context-toolbar { display: none; }
    .team-page[data-active-team-tab="maps"] .sk-detail-context-toolbar { display: none; }
    .team-page[data-active-team-tab="compare"] .sk-detail-context-toolbar { display: none; }
    /* Nor does a tab that only says what version 2.0 brings. */
    .team-page[data-active-team-tab="set-pieces"] .sk-detail-context-toolbar { display: none; }
    .team-page[data-active-team-tab="rival-analysis"] .sk-detail-context-toolbar { display: none; }
    .team-page[data-active-team-tab="autoreport"] .sk-detail-context-toolbar { display: none; }
    /*
    The filter cards and the charts are two grid items. The chart pair is 100%
    tall so it fills its column on the player page; sharing a box with the
    filters, that 100% took in their height too and the charts ran over the
    card below. Here the pair is as tall as its cards.
  */
  .team-grid > .sk-analysis-filters { grid-column: span 12; margin-bottom: 0; }
  .team-attribute-charts { grid-column: span 12; min-width: 0; }
  .team-attribute-charts .sk-analysis-chart-pair { height: auto; }
  /* Resultados: the label and note around the shared match list (match-list.css). */
  .team-matches__label { margin: 0 0 .75rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: .82rem; }
  .team-matches__count { color: var(--accent-ink); font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .team-matches__note { margin: .65rem 0 0; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: .72rem; }
  .team-empty { color: var(--text-muted); text-align: center; padding: 2.5rem 1rem; }
  .team-notice { display: flex; align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .4rem; margin: 0 0 .75rem; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: .82rem; }
  @media (max-width: 992px) {
    .team-card--span-3, .team-card--span-4, .team-card--span-5, .team-card--span-6, .team-card--span-7, .team-card--span-8 { grid-column: span 12; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .team-snapshot { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
    .team-formation-stats { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .team-chart-wrap { min-height: 380px; }
    .team-chart-wrap canvas { height: 380px !important; }
  }
</style>

<body>

  <div x-persist="sk-page-loader">
  <div class="sk-loader" data-page-loader="" hidden="" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="sk-loader__stage">
      <div class="sk-loader__mark">
        <span class="sk-loader__empty"></span>

        <span class="sk-loader__water">
          <span class="sk-loader__wave--back"></span>
          <span class="sk-loader__wave"></span>
          <span class="sk-loader__bubble"></span>
          <span class="sk-loader__bubble"></span>
          <span class="sk-loader__bubble"></span>
          <span class="sk-loader__bubble"></span>
        </span>

        <span class="sk-loader__shine"></span>
      </div>

      <p class="sk-loader__label">Cargando</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  /*
    Shown on wire:navigate, hidden on livewire:navigated.

    Two timings matter more than the animation does:

      DELAY        Most pages here render in well under 200ms. Flashing an
                   overlay on every click makes a fast app feel busy, so nothing
                   appears unless the navigation is actually slow enough to
                   notice.

      MIN_VISIBLE  Once it has appeared, it stays long enough to read as a
                   deliberate transition. Without this, a navigation finishing
                   at 210ms produces a 30ms flicker, which looks like a glitch
                   rather than a loader.

    Bound once per document: this file is inside the persisted region, and
    wire:navigate re-executes cloned <script> tags, so without the guard every
    navigation would add another pair of listeners.
  */
  (function () {
    if (window.skPageLoaderBound) return;
    window.skPageLoaderBound = true;

    const DELAY = 190;
    const MIN_VISIBLE = 620;
    const UNLOAD_FAILSAFE = 10000;

    let showTimer = null;
    let hideTimer = null;
    let failsafeTimer = null;
    let shownAt = 0;

    const el = () => document.querySelector('[data-page-loader]');

    function reveal() {
      const node = el();
      if (!node) return;

      node.hidden = false;
      node.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      node.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
      // Read back before adding the class so the opacity transition runs
      // instead of being collapsed with the display change.
      void node.offsetWidth;
      node.classList.add('is-visible');
      shownAt = Date.now();
    }

    function conceal() {
      const node = el();
      if (!node) return;

      node.classList.remove('is-visible');
      node.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      node.removeAttribute('aria-busy');

      // Kept in the layout until the fade finishes, then taken out of the
      // accessibility tree entirely.
      hideTimer = window.setTimeout(() => { node.hidden = true; }, 260);
    }

    // `armFailsafe` is only ever true for beforeunload; see the listeners below.
    function start(armFailsafe) {
      window.clearTimeout(showTimer);
      window.clearTimeout(hideTimer);
      window.clearTimeout(failsafeTimer);

      showTimer = window.setTimeout(reveal, DELAY);

      if (armFailsafe) {
        failsafeTimer = window.setTimeout(finish, UNLOAD_FAILSAFE);
      }
    }

    function finish() {
      window.clearTimeout(showTimer);
      window.clearTimeout(failsafeTimer);

      const node = el();

      if (!node || node.hidden) {
        shownAt = 0;

        return;
      }

      const elapsed = Date.now() - shownAt;

      if (elapsed >= MIN_VISIBLE) {
        conceal();
      } else {
        window.setTimeout(conceal, MIN_VISIBLE - elapsed);
      }
    }

    /*
      No failsafe on wire:navigate, deliberately.

      There was a blanket 10s timeout here, and it could not tell a navigation
      that had died from one that was merely slow. Any page slower than that had
      its overlay concealed mid-flight, dropping the user back on the page they
      had just left with no feedback until the response finally arrived — and a
      league page currently renders in 10–27s, so this was the ordinary case
      rather than the edge case. Raising the number only moves the cliff.

      Nothing here needs rescuing: a wire:navigate always resolves. Livewire
      either swaps the page in and fires livewire:navigated, or gives up and
      falls back to a full page load, which replaces this overlay along with the
      rest of the document.
    */
    document.addEventListener('livewire:navigate', () => start(false));
    document.addEventListener('livewire:navigated', finish);

    // Leaving for a full page load (a form post, a plain link) deserves the same
    // feedback, and this is the case that genuinely needs the timeout:
    // beforeunload also fires for things that do not actually unload the page —
    // a mailto:, a download, a cancelled navigation — and revealing without one
    // would strand the overlay on a page that never goes anywhere. The plans
    // page is full of mailto: links.
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => start(true));

    // Coming back through the cache should never show a stale overlay.
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', (event) => { if (event.persisted) finish(); });
  })();
</script>

  <script>
    // Navbar behaviour: the account dropdown and the search trigger.
    //
    // Bound once per document. wire:navigate rebuilds the body and clones its
    // <script> tags, which re-executes this file on every navigation, so
    // without the guard a second identical listener is added each time. Two
    // listeners defeat a toggle: the first opens the panel, the second reads it
    // as already open and closes it again, so the menu worked only on the page
    // that was loaded first. The listeners are delegated from `document`, which
    // is never replaced, so binding once is both necessary and sufficient.
    (function () {
      if (window.skNavbarBound) return;
      window.skNavbarBound = true;

      function closeAccountPanels(except) {
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-account-panel]').forEach((panel) => {
          if (panel === except) return;

          panel.hidden = true;
          panel.closest('[data-account-menu]')
            ?.querySelector('[data-account-trigger]')
            ?.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });
      }

      document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const trigger = event.target.closest('[data-account-trigger]');

        if (trigger) {
          const panel = trigger.closest('[data-account-menu]')?.querySelector('[data-account-panel]');
          const opening = panel?.hidden === true;

          closeAccountPanels(panel);

          if (panel) {
            panel.hidden = ! opening;
            trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', opening ? 'true' : 'false');
          }

          return;
        }

        // A click inside the panel (the logout form) must not close it first.
        if (event.target.closest('[data-account-panel]')) return;

        closeAccountPanels();
      });

      document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Escape') closeAccountPanels();
      });

      /*
        Which item is lit.

        The bar sits in a persisted region, so wire:navigate keeps this DOM
        rather than re-rendering it - which means the is-active class Blade wrote
        on the first load would still be describing that first page several
        navigations later.

        (Naming the directive here would be a mistake: Blade reads its own
        directives inside JavaScript comments too, and an unclosed one takes the
        whole template down with a 500.) Server-rendered markup cannot answer this on its own; it has to be
        recomputed on arrival.

        Ownership is by path prefix, because a section is more than one route:
        /league/{id} belongs to Ligas and /player/{id} to Scouting, and neither
        matches its own index URL.
      */
      function syncActiveNav() {
        const here = window.location.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/';

        document.querySelectorAll('.sk-navbar .nav-links [data-nav-match]').forEach((link) => {
          const owns = link.dataset.navMatch.split('|').some((candidate) => {
            let path;

            try {
              path = new URL(candidate, window.location.origin).pathname;
            } catch (error) {
              return false;
            }

            path = path.replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/';

            // Prefix, but only on a segment boundary: /player must not claim
            // /players.
            return here === path || here.startsWith(path + '/');
          });

          link.classList.toggle('is-active', owns);

          if (owns) {
            link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
          } else {
            link.removeAttribute('aria-current');
          }
        });
      }

      // Close on navigation: the navbar is persisted, so an open panel would
      // otherwise still be hanging open on the page just navigated to.
      document.addEventListener('livewire:navigated', () => {
        closeAccountPanels();
        syncActiveNav();
      });

      syncActiveNav();

      document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const trigger = event.target.closest('[data-open-navbar-search]');
        if (!trigger) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('navbar-search-open'));

        const drawer = document.getElementById('navDrawer');
        const navToggle = document.getElementById('navToggle');
        const navToggleIcon = document.getElementById('navToggleIcon');

        if (drawer?.classList.contains('open')) {
          drawer.classList.remove('open');
          navToggle?.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          if (navToggleIcon) navToggleIcon.className = 'bi bi-list';
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>

  <script>
    // ── Hamburger nav toggle ──────────────────────────────────
    (function () {
      const toggle = document.getElementById('navToggle');
      const drawer = document.getElementById('navDrawer');
      const icon   = document.getElementById('navToggleIcon');
      if (!toggle || !drawer) return;

      if (toggle.dataset.skBound !== '1') {
        toggle.dataset.skBound = '1';

        toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const open = drawer.classList.toggle('open');
          toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
          icon.className = open ? 'bi bi-x-lg' : 'bi bi-list';
        });

        // Delegated from the drawer so links added later still close it, and so
        // there is one listener to guard rather than one per link.
        drawer.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          if (!event.target.closest('a, button.btn-iniciar')) return;

          drawer.classList.remove('open');
          toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          icon.className = 'bi bi-list';
        });
      }

      // Sync mobile theme toggle with main toggle
      const mainToggle   = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
      const mobileToggle = document.getElementById('themeToggleMobile');
      const mobileIcon   = document.getElementById('themeIconMobile');

      if (mobileToggle && mainToggle && mobileToggle.dataset.skBound !== '1') {
        mobileToggle.dataset.skBound = '1';
        mobileToggle.addEventListener('click', () => mainToggle.click());

        new MutationObserver(() => {
          const mainIcon = document.getElementById('themeIcon');
          if (mobileIcon && mainIcon) mobileIcon.className = mainIcon.className;
        }).observe(document.getElementById('themeIcon'), { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
      }
    })();

    // ── Theme toggle ─────────────────────────────────────────
    (function () {
      const root = document.documentElement;
      const btn  = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
      const icon = document.getElementById('themeIcon');
      if (!btn) return;

      const stored = localStorage.getItem('sk-theme');
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
      const isDark = stored ? stored === 'dark' : prefersDark;

      function applyTheme(dark) {
        root.setAttribute('data-theme', dark ? 'dark' : 'light');
        if (icon) icon.className = dark ? 'bi bi-sun-fill' : 'bi bi-moon-fill';
        localStorage.setItem('sk-theme', dark ? 'dark' : 'light');
      }

      // Applying on every execution is harmless and keeps the icon in step
      // after a navigation; only the binding must not repeat.
      applyTheme(isDark);

      if (btn.dataset.skBound === '1') return;
      btn.dataset.skBound = '1';

      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        applyTheme(root.getAttribute('data-theme') !== 'dark');
      });
    })();
  </script>

  (function () {
    // Not window.skUsageNotice: the element's id already puts the <div>
    // there (named access on window), and the guard would never let this run.
    if (window.skShowUsageNotice) return;

    const fallback = "Recibimos demasiadas solicitudes seguidas. Espera un momento y vuelve a intentarlo.";
    let timer = null;

    function show(message) {
      const notice = document.getElementById('skUsageNotice');

      if (!notice) return;

      notice.querySelector('.sk-usage-notice__text').textContent = message || fallback;
      notice.hidden = false;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      timer = setTimeout(function () { notice.hidden = true; }, 9000);
    }

    window.skShowUsageNotice = show;

    window.addEventListener('sk-usage-limit', function (event) {
      show(event.detail && event.detail.message);
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      if (event.target.closest('.sk-usage-notice__close')) {
        const notice = document.getElementById('skUsageNotice');

        if (notice) notice.hidden = true;
      }
    });

    let intercepting = false;

    function intercept() {
      if (intercepting || !window.Livewire || typeof window.Livewire.interceptRequest !== 'function') return;

      intercepting = true;
      window.Livewire.interceptRequest(function ({ onError }) {
        onError(function ({ response, body, preventDefault }) {

          preventDefault();

          let message = fallback;

          try {

          } catch (e) {

          }

          show(message);
        });
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener('livewire:init', intercept);
    intercept();
  })();

  <script>
  (function () {
    const validTabs = ["overview","squad","stats","results","maps","compare","set-pieces","rival-analysis","autoreport"];
    let activeTeamTab = validTabs.includes(new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('tab'))
      ? new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('tab')
      : 'overview';

    function currentTeamPage() {
      return document.querySelector('[data-team-detail-page]');
    }

    function syncTeamTabVisibility(target) {
      const page = currentTeamPage();
      if (!page) return;

      const initial = page.dataset.initialTeamTab;
      const current = validTabs.includes(target)
        ? target
        : (validTabs.includes(initial) ? initial : activeTeamTab);

      activeTeamTab = current;
      page.dataset.activeTeamTab = current;

      page.querySelectorAll('.team-tab').forEach(tab => {
        const active = tab.dataset.teamTab === current;
        tab.classList.toggle('active', active);
        tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', active ? 'true' : 'false');
      });

      page.querySelectorAll('.team-tab-panel').forEach(panel => {
        panel.classList.toggle('is-active', panel.id === 'team-tab-' + current);
      });

      if (current === 'maps') {
        window.StatiskicksEventMap?.activate('team-detail-map');
        window.StatiskicksTeamPassNetwork?.boot();
      }

      if (current === 'overview') {
        window.StatiskicksTeamProfile?.activate('team-detail-profile');
        window.StatiskicksAttributeCharts?.activate('team-detail-attributes');
        window.StatiskicksTeamAgeProfile?.boot();
        window.StatiskicksTeamXgRolling?.boot();
      }
    }

    function replaceLegacyTeamUrl() {
      const page = currentTeamPage();
      if (!page || !page.dataset.canonicalUrl || !window.history?.replaceState) return;

      if (window.location.search || window.location.hash) {
        window.history.replaceState(window.history.state, '', page.dataset.canonicalUrl);
      }
    }

    function bootTeamDetail() {
      replaceLegacyTeamUrl();
      window.StatiskicksEventMap?.boot();
      window.StatiskicksTeamProfile?.boot();
      window.StatiskicksAttributeCharts?.boot();
      window.StatiskicksTeamAgeProfile?.boot();
      window.StatiskicksTeamXgRolling?.boot();
      window.StatiskicksTeamFormationProfile?.boot();
      syncTeamTabVisibility(activeTeamTab);
    }

    if (!window.__teamTabsClickRegistered) {
      window.__teamTabsClickRegistered = true;
      document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
        const tab = event.target.closest('.team-tab');
        if (!tab || !tab.dataset.teamTab) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        syncTeamTabVisibility(tab.dataset.teamTab);
      });

      document.addEventListener('team-filters-changed', function () {
        window.StatiskicksEventMap?.invalidate('team-detail-map', { filters: true });

        if (activeTeamTab === 'maps') {
          window.StatiskicksEventMap?.activate('team-detail-map');
          window.StatiskicksTeamPassNetwork?.boot();
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          window.StatiskicksTeamFormationProfile?.boot();

          if (activeTeamTab === 'overview') {
            window.StatiskicksTeamProfile?.activate('team-detail-profile');
            window.StatiskicksAttributeCharts?.activate('team-detail-attributes');
            window.StatiskicksTeamAgeProfile?.boot();
            window.StatiskicksTeamXgRolling?.boot();
          }
        });
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', bootTeamDetail);
    // Livewire fires this on the first load too, after DOMContentLoaded has
    // already replaced the url with its canonical, query-less form: the tab
    // the server rendered then stands for the ?tab= it was asked for.
    document.addEventListener('livewire:navigated', function () {
      const requested = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('tab');
      const rendered = currentTeamPage()?.dataset.initialTeamTab;

      activeTeamTab = validTabs.includes(requested)
        ? requested
        : (validTabs.includes(rendered) ? rendered : 'overview');
      bootTeamDetail();
    });

    document.addEventListener('livewire:init', function () {
      if (!window.Livewire || typeof window.Livewire.hook !== 'function') return;

      window.Livewire.hook('morph.updated', function () {
        requestAnimationFrame(bootTeamDetail);
      });
    });
  })();
</script>

  <script>
    (function () {
        const rawSearchUrl = "https:\/\/www.statiskicks.com\/search";

        function resolveSearchUrl(url) {
            const fallbackPath = '/search';

            try {
                const parsed = new URL(String(url || ''), window.location.origin);
                const path = parsed.pathname || fallbackPath;
                const query = parsed.search || '';
                return `${window.location.origin}${path}${query}`;
            } catch {
                const normalized = String(url || '').trim();
                const path = normalized
                    ? (normalized.startsWith('/') ? normalized : `/${normalized}`)
                    : fallbackPath;

                return `${window.location.origin}${path}`;
            }
        }

        const searchUrl = resolveSearchUrl(rawSearchUrl);

        function registerNavbarSearchPanel() {
            Alpine.data('navbarSearchPanel', () => ({
                open: false,
                activeTab: 'search',
                query: '',
                leagues: [],
                teams: [],
                players: [],
                recentItems: [],
                loading: false,
                // Over the search's ceiling (SK-19): the reason, said in the
                // panel instead of «no results», which would read as "no such
                // player".
                limited: '',
                searchUrl,
                searchTimer: null,
                searchController: null,

                init() {
                    this.loadRecent();
                    this.$watch('query', (value) => this.queueSearch(value));
                },

                openPanel() {
                    this.open = true;
                    this.activeTab = 'search';
                    document.body.classList.add('sk-search-open');
                    this.loadRecent();
                    this.$nextTick(() => this.$refs.searchInput?.focus());
                },

                closePanel() {
                    this.open = false;
                    this.query = '';
                    this.clearResults();
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.abortSearch();
                    document.body.classList.remove('sk-search-open');
                },

                queueSearch(value) {
                    this.abortSearch();
                    clearTimeout(this.searchTimer);
                    this.limited = '';

                    const term = String(value || '').trim();
                    if (term.length < 2) {
                        this.clearResults();
                        this.loading = false;
                        return;
                    }

                    this.loading = true;
                    this.searchTimer = setTimeout(() => this.runSearch(term), 350);
                },

                abortSearch() {
                    if (this.searchController) {
                        this.searchController.abort();
                        this.searchController = null;
                    }
                },

                async runSearch(term) {
                    this.abortSearch();
                    this.searchController = new AbortController();

                    try {
                        const response = await fetch(`${this.searchUrl}?q=${encodeURIComponent(term)}`, {
                            headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
                            signal: this.searchController.signal,
                        });

                        // Over the search's ceiling (SK-19): say so, rather
                        // than an empty list that reads as "no players".
                        if (response.status === 429) {
                            const limited = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
                            this.limited = limited.message || "Demasiadas b\u00fasquedas seguidas; espera un momento.";
                        }

                        if (!response.ok) {
                            throw new Error('Search failed');
                        }

                        const payload = await response.json();
                        if (String(this.query || '').trim() === term) {
                            this.leagues = Array.isArray(payload.leagues) ? payload.leagues : [];
                            this.teams = Array.isArray(payload.teams) ? payload.teams : [];
                            this.players = Array.isArray(payload.players) ? payload.players : [];
                        }
                    } catch (error) {
                        if (error?.name !== 'AbortError') {
                            this.clearResults();
                        }
                    } finally {
                        if (String(this.query || '').trim() === term) {
                            this.loading = false;
                        }
                        this.searchController = null;
                    }
                },

                clearResults() {
                    this.leagues = [];
                    this.teams = [];
                    this.players = [];
                },

                get hasResults() {
                    return this.leagues.length + this.teams.length + this.players.length > 0;
                },

                get sections() {
                    return [
                        { kind: 'league', title: 'Ligas', items: this.leagues },
                        { kind: 'team', title: 'Equipos', items: this.teams },
                        { kind: 'player', title: 'Jugadores', items: this.players },
                    ].filter((section) => section.items.length > 0);
                },

                loadRecent() {
                    try {
                        const stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sk-recent-players') || '[]');
                        this.recentItems = Array.isArray(stored) ? stored : [];
                    } catch {
                        this.recentItems = [];
                    }
                },

                // Entries saved before teams and leagues were searchable carry no kind: they are players.
                itemKind(item) {
                    return item?.kind || 'player';
                },

                selectResult(item, kind) {
                    if (!item?.id) {
                        this.closePanel();
                        return;
                    }

                    const entry = { ...item, kind };
                    const existing = this.recentItems.filter(
                        (recent) => !(recent.id === entry.id && this.itemKind(recent) === kind)
                    );
                    this.recentItems = [entry, ...existing].slice(0, 8);

                    try {
                        localStorage.setItem('sk-recent-players', JSON.stringify(this.recentItems));
                    } catch {
                        // ignore storage errors
                    }

                    this.closePanel();
                },

                resultImage(item, kind) {
                    if (item?.image) {
                        return item.image;
                    }

                    const fallback = { league: 'Liga', team: 'Equipo', player: 'Jugador' }[kind] || 'Jugador';
                    const name = encodeURIComponent(item?.name || fallback);
                    return `https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=${name}&background=1D665D&color=fff&size=80`;
                },

                resultMeta(item, kind) {
                    if (kind === 'league') {
                        return item?.country || '—';
                    }

                    if (kind === 'team') {
                        return item?.competition || '—';
                    }

                    return [item?.role, item?.team].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || '—';
                },

                resultFlag(item, kind) {
                    if (kind === 'league') {
                        return String(item?.alpha2 || '').toLowerCase();
                    }

                    return kind === 'player' ? (item?.flag || '') : '';
                },
            }));
        }

        function bootNavbarSearchPanel() {
            if (typeof Alpine === 'undefined') {
                return;
            }

            registerNavbarSearchPanel();

            document.querySelectorAll('#navbarSearchRoot[x-data]').forEach((element) => {
                if (!element.__x) {
                    Alpine.initTree(element);
                }
            });
        }

        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', registerNavbarSearchPanel);
        document.addEventListener('livewire:navigated', bootNavbarSearchPanel);

        if (typeof Alpine !== 'undefined') {
            bootNavbarSearchPanel();
        }
    })();
</script>
